name: Tabib Wasit Khan
story: I’m from Bangladesh and have been living in St. John’s for more than three years. I’m a fourth-year Economics student at Memorial University of Newfoundland, pursuing a Minor in Business Administration and a Diploma in Public Policy, with an expected graduation in 2027. I have been through the full experience of moving abroad, figuring things out one step at a time and I genuinely enjoy helping others do the same. Whether it is settling in, finding work, navigating university life or just feeling a little less lost, I am happy to support however I can. Fun fact: I am a shameless binge watcher. If I start a show I like, I have to finish it in one sitting, even if it means staying up until 4 a.m. I just cannot deal with cliffhangers!
